criteria.c0: Every Claude Code launch of the Build has `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` equal to `<harness home>/claude`, `CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR` equal to the scope path resolved from the control root at admission, and the caller's real `HOME`; every variable that `Kogen.ClaudeCode.environment/2` removes at 2909f557 (the `ANTHROPIC_`, `CLAUDE_CODE_`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and `CLAUDECODE` prefixes, `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK`, `VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE`) plus the inherited `CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR` is absent or replaced, asserted in the environment the launched child process actually sees.
criteria.c1: Every Codex launch has `CODEX_HOME` equal to its scope, its operation root (private `HOME`, `XDG_*`, sqlite) under `<harness home>/codex`, and every variable in Codex's existing blocked set (including `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`) removed.
criteria.c2: Readiness ran with the Build's own launch environment before any model launch.
criteria.c3: The switched selector does not change any later launch of the running Build.
criteria.c4: The owner record and tracking record name each binding (harness, scope name and path, runtime version).
criteria.c5: A Claude scope directory's file list is identical before and after a fake Build, and a Codex scope differs at most by the two deterministic files Kogen already maintains there (`environments.toml`, `agents/kogen_boundary.toml`), pre-seeded in the fixture; no credential file in either scope is created, copied, linked, moved, renamed or rewritten by Kogen, no Kogen code path invokes `security` or opens a credential file, and a marker written into one Build's harness home is absent from a second Build's launch environment and home.
criteria.c6: Every other Kogen Claude Code launch (Shape, login, status) sets `CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR` equal to its `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, overriding an inherited value.
criteria.c7: In the real fixture, the Build's Developer transcript (with its session id from the tracking record) exists under `<harness home>/claude/projects/` and not under the scope's `projects/`, the Developer completed a turn and a resume there, the tracking record's Claude binding names the scope path, and the Shape session's transcripts are under that scope's `projects/`.
